notes.title: Kickstarter 2024 Campaign Announcement
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that we will be having a Kickstarter campaign later this year for Shadows of Glory. Visit shadowsofglory.com/kickstarter to know when the campaign start date and other related news is announced.
